name: Nantipa Beach & Resort
positioning: Hotel Nantipa, a beachfront boutique hotel in Santa Teresa on Costa Rica's Nicoya Peninsula, with plunge-pool bungalows, beachfront villas and an open-air wellness center
best_for: Couples wanting a beachfront bungalow with a private plunge pool
Families or groups wanting a suite or a private beachfront villa
Wellness travelers interested in daily yoga and Blue Zone living

facts.text: Hotel Nantipa is a beachfront boutique hotel in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, on the Nicoya Peninsula.
The Nicoya Peninsula, where Nantipa is located, is one of the world's five Blue Zones.
The beach, surf breaks, local restaurants and the Santa Teresa strip are within walking distance of the hotel.
In the Manti bungalows, floor-to-ceiling glass doors open to garden views, surrounded by forest.
The Nanku Suites are designed for small families or groups.
Numu offers daily yoga, meditation, breathwork, Pilates and sound healing sessions.
Nantipa has a dedicated Yoga Shala.
Numu's treatments use natural, eco-conscious products and locally inspired ingredients.
Manzu is the hotel's beachfront restaurant, serving Costa Rican cuisine with a refined twist alongside sunset cocktails.
Nantipa supports reforestation initiatives, beach preservation and community engagement.
The concierge team can arrange private drivers for day trips to Montezuma and Cabo Blanco Nature Reserve.
Bicycles are available at the hotel.

highlights.text: The Ninta Beachfront Bungalows each have a terrace, a private plunge pool, a hammock and a double indoor/outdoor shower, with floor-to-ceiling glass doors opening to ocean views.
The Beachfront Villas are private three-bedroom villas with direct beach access, a fully equipped kitchen and a private pool.
Numu Wellness Center is an open-air wellness space set within the Nantipa Gardens.
Ninta, the name of the beachfront bungalows, is the Chorotegan word for beach.
Tabacon Thermal Resort & Spa in the Arenal Volcano region is Nantipa's sister property, and retreats can extend there.

considerations.text: The closest airstrip is Cobano Airport, reached by daily scheduled flights from San Jose operated by SANSA and Green Airways.
Guests can drive or take a private transfer from San Jose via Route 27 and the Puntarenas-Paquera ferry.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires longer travel time.
